blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models predict dense point maps from multiple images in a single pass. Without explicit geometric constraints, however, their predictions are often inconsistent across views and lack fine-grained precision. Recent methods incorporate geometric priors such as camera pose or depth, but use them merely as auxiliary inputs, process each view independently, or refine the geometry only where the priors are available. We present Refin3R, which refines feed-forward point maps with Structure-from-Motion (SfM) points, propagating SfM geometry over the image grid. In its dual-branch architecture, a 2D branch extends SfM geometry beyond its coverage using geometry-aware backbone features, while a 3D branch reasons over the SfM points of all views, capturing multi-view structure that the image grid alone cannot represent. The two branches exchange information bidirectionally to jointly refine each view, yielding dense and accurate point maps. Across ScanNet++, ETH3D, Tanks\&Temples, and out-of-domain human and surgical scenes, Refin3R consistently outperforms feed-forward and geometry-guided methods in point map accuracy while running faster than the strongest geometry-guided baseline.
blocks.zh: Feed-forward 三维重建模型预测出从多幅图像中以单行道得到的密集点地图. 然而,如果没有明确的几何限制,它们的预测往往在各种观点上不一致,缺乏精细的精确度. 近代方法包含了相机姿势或深度等几何前缀,但仅作为辅助输入使用,独立处理每个视图,或者只在有前缀的情况下再细化几何. 我们提出Refine3R,它用结构-从-运动(SfM)点来改进向导点地图,在图像网格上宣传SfM几何. 在其双分支架构中,一个2D分支利用几何-认知主干特征将SfM几何扩展出覆盖范围以外,而一个3D分支因在所有观点的SfM点之上,捕获了图像网格单独无法代表的多视图结构. 两个分支双向交换信息,共同完善每个视图,产生密集而准确的点图. 在整个ScanNet++、ETH3D、Tanks-Qemples以及领域外的人类和外科场景中,Refine3R在点地图精确度方面一贯优于饲料前进和几何制导方法,同时运行速度快于最强的几何制导基线。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Multi-view 3D reconstruction from RGB images is a long-standing problem in computer vision.
Recent feed-forward methods [ 52 , 49 , 27 ] , trained on large-scale datasets, predict dense point maps for all views in a single forward pass. Their fast and scalable inference has established this paradigm as a promising direction, and follow-up works are rapidly emerging [ 55 , 20 , 50 ] . However, these models regress point maps purely from learned priors, without enforcing explicit geometric constraints such as triangulation [ 15 ] . As a result, their predictions are often inconsistent across views and lack fine-grained precision.
blocks.zh:
来自RGB图像的多视图3D重建是计算机视觉中长期存在的问题.
近代的向导方法[52,49,27],训练有素的大型数据集,以单一的向前行传预测所有视图的密集点图. 他们的快速和可扩展的推论将这一范式确立为一个有希望的方向,后续作品正在迅速出现[55,20,50]. 然而,这些模型完全从学到的往事中递归点图,而没有强制实施三角化等明确的几何限制[15]. 因此,他们的预测往往在各种观点上不一致,缺乏精细的精确度.

blocks.en: Structure-from-Motion (SfM) [ 40 , 32 , 58 , 1 ] , in contrast, establishes correspondences across images and triangulates them under explicit multi-view constraints, yielding consistent and accurate points. Yet it often recovers only sparse geometry and becomes fragile under wide baselines or low overlap [ 41 , 35 ] . Moreover, since it relies solely on correspondences without semantic understanding, mismatches can introduce outliers [ 5 ] . The two paradigms are thus complementary: feed-forward models are dense but imprecise, whereas SfM is accurate but incomplete.
blocks.zh: 结构动(SfM)[40,32,58,1]形成对比,建立图像之间的对应关系,并在明确的多视图限制下进行三角化,得出一致和准确的点. 然而,它往往只恢复稀少的几何特征,在宽基线或低重叠度下变得脆弱[41,35]. 此外,由于它完全依赖没有语义理解的函证,不匹配可以引入外延[5]. 这两种模式因此是相辅相成的:向导模型密集但不准确,而SfM则准确但不完整。

blocks.en:
Recent works incorporate explicit geometric cues, such as correspondences, camera poses, or depth, into feed-forward reconstruction.
Optimization-based methods [ 9 , 26 ] match pixels across views with learned matchers and jointly refine cameras and dense depth, initialized from feed-forward predictions. However, they adjust depth only via a coarse grid of anchor depths or a few per-image coefficients, limiting fine-grained refinement.
Learning-based methods instead feed geometric priors into networks: geometry-conditioned feed-forward models [ 19 , 20 ] take cameras or depth as extra inputs, and depth completion methods [ 14 , 65 , 64 ] densify sparse depth under image guidance. However, the former use the priors merely as auxiliary inputs, while the latter process each view independently, ignoring the 3D structure shared across views.
blocks.zh:
近期的作品中包含了明确的几何提示,如通信,相机姿势或深度,用于向导重建.
以优化为基础的方法[9,26]将跨视线的像素与所学的匹配者匹配,并联合精炼相机和密集深度,从向导预测中初始化. 然而,它们只通过粗网的锚深或少数的偶成系数来调整深度,限制了精细的精细化.
基于学习的方法转而将几何前缀输入网络:几何条件的向导模型[19,20]将相机或深度作为额外输入,深度完成方法[14,65,64]在图像引导下将稀疏的深度去化. 然而,前者仅使用前缀作为辅助输入,而后者则独立处理每个视图,忽略了各种观点共享的3D结构.

blocks.en:
Closer to our work, GGPT [ 6 ] refines the feed-forward point maps of all views jointly in 3D space with accurate points from its SfM pipeline, enforcing multi-view consistency around these points.
However, it refines local cubic patches of points from geometric inputs alone, so its refinement remains largely confined to the regions covered by SfM.
Areas without such coverage, typically textureless surfaces and regions observed by a single view, thus benefit little from the SfM guidance (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
靠近我们的工作,GGPT[6]用它的SfM管道的准确点,在3D空间共同完善所有观点的向导点图,围绕这些点执行多视图一致性.
然而,它仅从几何输入中精炼出局部立方形的点块,因此其精炼仍基本局限于SfM覆盖的区域.
没有这种覆盖的区域,一般是无纹理的表面和单一观点观察到的区域,因此很少受益于SfM指南(图1)。

blocks.en:
Motivated by these limitations, we propose Refin3R , which refines the feed-forward point maps as per-view depth on the image grid rather than as points in 3D space.
Operating on the image grid allows Refin3R to leverage the dense image features of the pretrained feed-forward backbone [ 27 , 55 ] , which guide the refinement across the whole image.
In addition, Refin3R exploits the SfM points of all views in 3D, so that each view is refined with the multi-view structure of the scene rather than only the points it observes.
By combining both, Refin3R recovers accurate point maps even in regions without SfM coverage (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
基于这些限制,我们提出Refine3R,它精炼了图像网格上的视深而不是3D空间中的点的向导点图.
在图像网格上操作,可以使Refine3R利用预先训练的feed-forward主干线的密集图像特征[27,55],指导整个图像的完善.
此外,Refine3R还利用了3D中所有观点的SfM点,使每个观点都用场景的多视图结构来细化,而不仅仅是它观察到的点.
通过两者的结合,Refine3R恢复了准确的点图,甚至在没有SfM覆盖的区域(图1).

blocks.en:
We realize this with a dual-branch architecture: a 2D branch on the image grid and a 3D branch on sparse voxels.
The 2D branch refines the feed-forward depth of each view with its own SfM depth, guided by the dense image features from the feed-forward backbone, whose semantic and geometric cues let the SfM depth propagate beyond its coverage. This per-view input, however, holds at most one depth per pixel, so SfM points occluded in the current view or triangulated only from other views are left out.
The 3D branch complements it by gathering the SfM points of all views into sparse voxels within the space seen by each view, providing a richer 3D structure than the view’s own SfM depth.
As each voxel is indexed by a pixel and a depth bin, the two branches share the same pixel coordinates and exchange information: the 2D branch receives the multi-view evidence that the image grid alone cannot represent, and the 3D branch receives the image context around each point.
Spatial propagation then fuses their predictions into the refined depth, which is back-projected to obtain the refined point maps.
blocks.zh:
我们用双分支结构来意识到这一点:图像网格上的2D分支和稀疏的阴道上的3D分支.
2D分支用自己的SfM深度来精炼每个景点的向导深度,以来自向导主干线的密集图像特征为指导,其语义和几何提示让SfM深度传播到覆盖范围以外. 然而,这种每个视图输入最多每个像素保持一个深度,所以SfM点在目前视图中占据或三角仅来自其他视图被忽略.
3D分支通过将所有观点的 SfM 点集合到每个视图所看到的空间内的稀疏的voxels来补充它,提供了比视图本身的 SfM 深度更丰富的3D 结构.
由于每个 voxel 被像素和深度 bin 索引,两个分支共享相同的像素坐标和交换信息: 2D 分支接收图像网格单独不能代表的多视图证据,3D 分支接收每个点周围的图像上下文.
然后进行空间传播,将预测纳入精密的深度,而精密的深度是用来获取精密的点图的。

blocks.en: Extensive experiments show that Refin3R achieves state-of-the-art point map accuracy on both standard and out-of-domain benchmarks, consistently outperforming feed-forward and geometry-guided methods by a large margin. Moreover, while sharing its SfM front-end with the strongest geometry-guided baseline, Refin3R runs substantially faster, making it an efficient refinement module for feed-forward 3D reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 广泛的实验表明,Refine3R在标准基准和域外基准上都实现了最先进的点图精度,以很大的比例一贯地优于饲料前进和几何制导方法. 此外,在与最强的几何导基准共享其SfM前端的同时,Refine3R运行速度大大加快,使其成为一个高效的向导3D重建的改进模块.

blocks.en: 2 Related works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 3D reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.1 三维重建

blocks.en:
Multi-view 3D reconstruction has long been studied in computer vision, with its foundations in classical multi-view geometry [ 32 , 2 , 13 , 16 ] , and has matured into practical SfM systems [ 1 , 58 , 18 , 34 ] such as COLMAP [ 40 ] .
Learning-based components have since been integrated throughout the SfM pipeline, from feature detection and matching [ 8 , 39 , 30 , 43 , 10 , 12 , 11 , 63 , 23 ] to track refinement [ 29 , 17 , 24 ] . Beyond individual components, VGGSfM [ 51 ] makes the entire pipeline end-to-end differentiable, while MP-SfM [ 35 ] leverages monocular priors to improve robustness under low overlap.
Recently, feed-forward reconstruction models infer scene geometry and camera parameters directly from images. Pairwise models [ 52 , 25 ] regress point maps from image pairs but require a global alignment for more views, whereas subsequent multi-view models [ 49 , 50 , 55 , 27 , 20 ] process all views jointly in a single forward pass. Trained on large-scale 3D data, these models are fast and robust in sparse-view settings, yet without explicit geometric constraints their predictions often lack multi-view consistency and local precision, especially on out-of-domain scenes.
blocks.zh:
多景3D重建长期在计算机视觉中被研究,其基础为古典多景几何[32,2,13,16],已成熟为实用的SfM系统[1,58,18,34],如COLMAP[40].
从此以后,在SfM输油管的整个过程中,从特征检测和匹配[8、39、30、43、10、12、11、63、23]到跟踪完善[29、17、24],都纳入了基于学习的组件。 除了单个组件之外,VGGSfM [51] 使得整个管道的端对端可互不相同,而MP-SfM [35] 则利用单元前缀在低重叠度下提高稳健性.
最近,向导重建模型直接从图像中推断出场景几何和相机参数. 对等模型 [52, 25] 从图像对面递归点图, 但需要全局对齐以获取更多视图, 而随后的多视图模型 [49, 50, 55, 27, 20] 将所有视图在一个单向前行处理 。 这些模型在大规模3D数据上接受培训,在短视环境中快速而有力,然而没有明显的几何限制,它们的预测往往缺乏多视一致性和局部精确度,特别是在域外场景上.

blocks.en: 2.2 Geometry-guided reconstruction
blocks.zh: 2.2 几何制导重建

blocks.en:
Recent works leverage both feed-forward models and multi-view geometry, following two directions. One direction refines feed-forward predictions by correspondence-based optimization. VGGT+BA [ 49 ] refines the predicted cameras through bundle adjustment [ 45 ] to improve their accuracy, and MASt3R-SfM [ 9 ] and BLASt3R [ 26 ] further optimize dense depth jointly with the cameras.
The other direction feeds geometric priors into feed-forward models, e.g . , multi-view transformers that take camera parameters or depth as optional inputs [ 19 , 20 , 55 ] .
Most closely related, GGPT [ 6 ] combines both directions: it obtains accurate SfM points with dense matching, sparse bundle adjustment initialized by feed-forward predictions, and linear triangulation [ 16 ] , and refines the feed-forward point maps with them using a 3D point transformer [ 59 ] .
We adopt its SfM pipeline but refine depth in the image domain with geometry-aware image features, while aggregating the SfM points of all views in 3D.
blocks.zh:
近期的作品既利用了向导模型,也利用了多景几何,遵循了两个方向. 一个方向通过基于函证的优化来完善向导预测. VGGT+BA [49]通过捆绑调整来完善预测的相机,以提高其准确性,MASt3R-SfM [9]和BLASt3R [26]与相机进一步优化密度深度.
另一方向将几何前缀输入到向导模型中,例如,取相机参数或深度作为可选输入的多视图变压器[19,20,55].
最密切相关的是,GGPT[6]结合了两个方向:它以密集的匹配获得精确的SfM点,通过向导预测初始化的散装调整,以及线性三角化[16],并用3D点变压器对向导点图进行精细化. [59].
我们采用了它的SfM管道,但精炼了图像域的深度,具有几何感知的图像特征,同时汇总了3D中所有视图的SfM点.

blocks.en: 2.3 Depth completion
blocks.zh: 2.3 深度完成

blocks.en:
Geometry-guided reconstruction is closely related to depth completion, which densifies sparse depth, typically from LiDAR [ 62 , 48 , 47 , 65 ] , under image guidance, with recent methods leveraging monocular depth foundation models [ 64 , 56 ] .
Following this formulation, Murre [ 14 ] performs multi-view reconstruction by guiding a monocular diffusion model with the SfM depth of each view.
However, these methods process each view independently and only use the measurements observed in that view. Our image-domain refinement shares this spirit, but both the image features and the SfM evidence in our method are multi-view: the features come from a multi-view feed-forward model, and the 3D branch aggregates the SfM points of all views.
blocks.zh:
几何制导重建与深度完成密切相关,深度完成使稀疏深度变暗,一般来自LiDAR[62,48,47,65],在图像引导下,最近的方法利用了单质深度基础模型[64,56].
按照这个配方,Murre [14] 进行多视图重建,通过指导每个视图的SfM深度的单视扩散模型.
然而,这些方法独立处理每一种观点,只使用这种观点中观察到的测量结果。 我们的图像域改进与这种精神相同,但是我们方法中的图像特性和SfM证据都是多视图的:这些特性来自多视图的feed-forward模型,3D分支汇总了所有视图的SfM点.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 概览

blocks.en:
Given N N RGB images { I i } i = 1 N \{I_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} , our goal is to reconstruct a dense point map P i ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 P_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} for each view in a shared coordinate system. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , Refin3R first obtains two complementary reconstructions: a dense but less accurate one from a feed-forward model and a partial but accurate one from SfM.
Representing both as pixel-aligned depth maps of each view (Sec. 3.2 ), it then refines the feed-forward depth on the image grid with per-pixel residuals guided by the SfM points.
blocks.zh:
鉴于N N RGB 图像 { I } i = 1 N \{i}\}_{i=i=1}^{N },我们的目标是重建密集点地图 P i ∈ R ×X W×3 P_{i}\in\ mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3}对共享坐标系统中的每个视图. 如图2所示,Refine3R首先获得两个互补的重建:一个是密集但不太准确的,来自向导模型,另一个是部分但准确的,来自SfM.
它既代表每个视图的像素对齐深度图(Sec. 3.2),又以SfM点为引导,精炼图像网格上的向导深度.

blocks.en:
The refinement is performed by a dual-branch network that takes both reconstructions along with geometry-aware features from the feed-forward backbone (Sec. 3.3 ).
Its 2D branch combines the feed-forward and SfM depth of each view with these features and refines the dense depth on the image grid.
In parallel, its 3D branch refines the depth at the SfM-observed pixels of the current view, leveraging the SfM points aggregated from all views in sparse voxels.
The two branches exchange information (Sec. 3.4 ), and a spatial fusion stage merges their estimates across the image through iterative spatial propagation (Sec. 3.5 ). Finally, the refined depth D i p ​ r ​ e ​ d D^{pred}_{i} is back-projected along the pixel rays of the SfM cameras to obtain the point map P i P_{i} of each view.
blocks.zh:
改进工作由一个双重分支网络进行,该网络既要进行重建,又要利用向导主干线的几何意识特征(第3.3条)。
它的2D分支将每个视图的向导深度和SfM深度与这些特征相结合,并完善了图像网格上的密集深度.
同时,它的3D分支对当前视图的SfM-observated像素的深度进行了精炼,利用了从所有视图中以稀疏的Voxels汇总的SfM点.
两个分支交换信息(第3.4节),空间聚变阶段通过迭代空间传播(第3.5节),将整个图像的估计数合并。 最后,精密的深度D i p r d d ^{pred}_{i} 沿着SfM相机的像素射线进行反投射,以获得每个视图的点图P i P_{i}.

blocks.en: 3.2 Input representation
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 投入说明

blocks.en: Following GGPT [ 6 ] , we obtain two initial reconstructions. A pretrained multi-view feed-forward model, such as Depth Anything 3 (DA3) [ 27 ] or Pi3X [ 55 ] , first predicts initial camera parameters and a dense depth map D i ff ∈ ℝ H × W D^{\mathrm{ff}}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W} for every view. Building on this prediction, an SfM pipeline establishes correspondences with RoMa v2 [ 11 ] , refines the cameras ( 𝐊 i , 𝐑 i , 𝐭 i ) (\mathbf{K}_{i},\mathbf{R}_{i},\mathbf{t}_{i}) by sparse bundle adjustment, and triangulates valid tracks by multi-view DLT [ 15 ] ; see GGPT [ 6 ] for details. This yields a partial SfM depth map D i sfm D^{\mathrm{sfm}}_{i} with a validity mask M i ∈ { 0 , 1 } H × W M_{i}\in\{0,1\}^{H\times W} marking triangulated pixels.

Our setting resembles depth completion, which densifies sparse depth measurements under RGB guidance [ 64 , 65 , 14 ] , but differs in two aspects: the feed-forward depth already provides a dense initial estimate, and the partial measurements come from all views rather than the current one alone. We therefore design one branch for each: a dense 2D branch that refines the feed-forward depth on the image grid, and a sparse 3D branch that refines the SfM depth using the points of all views.

We therefore employ spatial propagation [ 7 ] , which iteratively updates a dense depth map with learned, content-dependent neighbor weights to mix the two estimates adaptively across the entire image.

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.1 详细执行情况

blocks.en: For both training and evaluation, we obtain the initial reconstructions from a feed-forward backbone, either DA3 [ 27 ] or Pi3X [ 55 ] , and the SfM pipeline of GGPT [ 6 ] (Sec. 3.2 ); we report results for both versions, each trained separately. The 2D branch follows the U-Net of PacGDC [ 47 ] , the DPT head follows the architecture of the DA3 depth head, and the 3D branch follows the sparse U-Net of MoGe-3 [ 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了培训和评价,我们从一个向导主干线(DA3[27]或Pi3X[55])和GGPT的SfM输油管获得初步重建;我们报告两个版本的结果,每个版本分别培训。 2D分支遵循PacGDC的U-Net [47],DPT头遵循DA3深度头的架构,3D分支遵循MoGe-3的稀疏U-Net [22].

blocks.en:
We train on the training splits of ScanNet++ [ 61 ] , TartanAir v2 [ 54 , 63 ] , UnrealStereo4K [ 44 ] , and BlendedMVS [ 60 ] , all of which provide dense ground-truth depth and camera poses. Following MapAnything [ 20 ] , we sample multi-view sets via a covisibility-constrained random walk, with 4 4 – 16 16 views for ScanNet++, 4 4 – 8 8 views for TartanAir v2 and UnrealStereo4K, and 3 3 – 6 6 for BlendedMVS. We train for 200 200 K iterations on 4 4 NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPUs using AdamW [ 31 ] with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and weight decay 0.05 0.05 .
The learning rate is linearly warmed up over the first 2 2 K iterations and then cosine-decayed to 10 − 5 10^{-5} . Further architectural and training details are in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价协议

blocks.en:
Following GGPT [ 6 ] , we evaluate on ScanNet++ [ 61 ] , ETH3D [ 42 ] , and Tanks&Temples [ 21 ] , each with 4-, 8-, and 16-view splits.
Since ScanNet++ is part of our training data, we refer to it as within-domain, and to ETH3D and Tanks&Temples as cross-domain.
We further evaluate on two out-of-domain datasets whose appearance and geometry differ substantially from the training data: 4D-DRESS [ 53 ] , rendered from high-resolution scans of clothed humans, and MV-dVRK [ 4 ] , photorealistic renderings of robotic abdominal surgery.
blocks.zh:
GUGPT [6] 之后,我们通过ScanNet++ [61],ETH3D [42],以及Tanks & Temples [21] 来评价,每集有4-,8-和16-视图的分割.
由于ScanNet++是我们训练数据的一部分,我们将其称为域内数据,并将ETH3D和Tanks&Temples称为跨域数据.
我们进一步评价两个外域数据集,其外观和几何学与训练数据大不相同:4D-DRESS [53],由布衣人类的高分辨率扫描所提供;MV-dVRK [4],机器人腹部手术的光现实化渲染.

blocks.en: We evaluate point map accuracy with the area under the accuracy curve (AUC) at several error thresholds. We align each predicted point map to the metric ground truth with robust Umeyama alignment [ 46 ] implemented in pycolmap [ 40 ] , and measure the Euclidean error between each predicted point and its ground-truth counterpart.
blocks.zh: 我们用精确曲线下的区域(AUC)在几个误差阈值上对点地图精确度进行评估。 我们把每个预测点的地图与标尺的地面真理一致,并用pycolmap [40] 执行的强力Umeyama对齐[46],测量每个预测点与地面真理对应点之间的欧几里得误差。

blocks.en:
We compare against four groups of methods.
For fairness, all methods that take geometric priors receive the same SfM output as ours.
(1) Feed-forward models : DA3 [ 27 ] , Pi3X (RGB only) [ 55 ] , and VGGT- Ω \Omega [ 50 ] , which take only images as input.
(2) Geometry-conditioned feed-forward models : MapAnything [ 20 ] and Pi3X, conditioned on our SfM cameras and the per-view SfM depth D i sfm D^{\text{sfm}}_{i} (Sec. 3.2 ).
(3) Depth completion : Murre [ 14 ] and Any2Full [ 64 ] , which complete D i sfm D^{\text{sfm}}_{i} of each view independently; the results are back-projected with the SfM cameras into a global point map.
(4) Feed-forward reconstruction with multi-view geometry : MASt3R-SfM [ 9 ] and BLASt3R [ 26 ] , which run their own pipelines to jointly optimize cameras and dense depth using correspondences and depth priors, and GGPT [ 6 ] , which refines the feed-forward point maps with the SfM points in 3D. We apply GGPT to the same DA3 and Pi3X initial reconstructions as ours.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了四组方法。
为了公平起见,所有使用几何前缀的方法都会得到与我们相同的SfM输出.
(1) Feed-forward models : DA3 [27], Pi3X(仅RGB) [55],和 V GUGT- 组合 [50],仅将图像作为输入.
(2) 几何条件饲料前导模型: Map anything [20] and Pi3X,以我们的SfM相机和per-view SfM深度D i sfm D^{\text{sfm}}_{i}为条件(第3.2节).
(3)深度完成 : Murre [14] 和 Any2Full [64],独立完成每个视图的D i sfm D^{\text{sfm}}_{i};结果与 SfM 相机反射成全局点图.
(4)多景几何的Feed-forward重建:MAT3R-SfM[9]和BLAST3R[26],它们运行自己的管道,通过函授和深度前传共同优化相机和密集深度,GGPT[6],用3D的SfM点来完善Feed-forward点图. 我们把GGPT应用于与我们相同的DA3和Pi3X初始重建.

blocks.en: Refining the feed-forward depth on the image grid from the geometric channels of Eq. ( 2 ) alone (a) already outperforms GGPT by a large margin, showing the benefit of refining on the image grid rather than as points in 3D. Adding the backbone features (b) further improves accuracy, as they provide geometric cues where the SfM depth alone is insufficient.
blocks.zh: 仅从Eq. (2)的几何通道精炼图像网格上的向导深度(a)就已经大大超过GGPT,显示在图像网格上精炼的好处而不是3D中的点. 增加主干功能(b) 进一步提高准确性,因为这些功能在SfM深度不足的地方提供几何提示。

blocks.en: Adding the 3D branch with bidirectional interaction (c) brings consistent gains on both datasets. Since the 3D-branch depth is used only for supervision in this variant, these gains come solely from the feature exchange, which provides the 2D branch with multi-view evidence beyond the view’s own SfM depth.
blocks.zh: 将3D分支加成双向交互(c),为两个数据集带来一致的收益. 由于3D分支深度在此变体中仅用于监理,这些收益完全来自特征交换,为2D分支提供了超出该视图自身SfM深度的多视图证据.

blocks.en:
Substituting the 3D-branch depth on SfM-observed pixels at test time already helps, confirming that the 3D branch refines these pixels more accurately than the 2D branch.
However, hard substitution trusts every triangulated pixel equally and leaves its neighbors untouched.
Spatial fusion (d) instead anchors this depth with learned confidence and propagates it through learned affinities, yielding the best results.
blocks.zh:
在测试时间替换SfM观测像素上的3D-分支深度已经有所帮助,确认3D分支比2D分支更准确地完善这些像素.
然而,硬置换信任每一个三角像素,使其邻居不受影响.
空间聚变(d)则以所学到的信心支撑这一深度,并通过所学到的亲缘关系加以传播,产生最佳结果。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented Refin3R, which refines feed-forward 3D reconstructions on the image grid of each view, guided by the SfM points of all views aggregated in 3D.
Its dual-branch architecture couples dense image features with multi-view SfM evidence through bidirectional interaction, and spatial fusion propagates the refined geometry across the whole image.
Refin3R achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on standard and out-of-domain benchmarks, consistently outperforming feed-forward and geometry-guided methods while adding little overhead to the SfM front-end.
blocks.zh:
我们介绍了Refine3R,它精炼了每个视图图像网格上的向导3D重建,以3D集合的所有视图的SfM点为指导.
它的双分支结构配对密集的图像特征,通过双向相互作用具有多视SfM证据,空间聚变将精密的几何传播到整个图像中.
Refine3R在标准基准和域外基准上实现了最先进的准确性,一贯优于饲料前进和几何制导方法,同时在SfM前端增加了很少的间接费用.
